question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
WITH top_drivers AS (
    SELECT r.year, d.driver_id, d.full_name, SUM(ds.points) as total_points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN drivers_ext d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
    GROUP BY r.year, d.driver_id, d.full_name
),
ranked_drivers AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, full_name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points DESC) as rank
    FROM top_drivers
),
top_drivers_final AS (
    SELECT year, full_name
    FROM ranked_drivers
    WHERE rank = 1
),
top_constructors AS (
    SELECT r.year, c.name as constructor_name, SUM(cs.points) as total_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    GROUP BY r.year, c.name
),
ranked_constructors AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points DESC) as rank
    FROM top_constructors
),
top_constructors_final AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_name
    FROM ranked_constructors
    WHERE rank = 1
)
SELECT df.year, df.full_name as top_driver, tc.constructor_name as top_constructor
FROM top_drivers_final df
JOIN top_constructors_final tc ON df.year = tc.year
ORDER BY df.year
